# Every room type through the native room editor on a fresh level 12: Quick
# Build's Customise, a door by marker (counting how many markers the game
# accepts), one window, Auto for the furniture, then Done. Each step gives up
# after a deadline rather than failing, so one bad room doesn't hide the rest.
# (Generated by a loop; test set-up only: rooms discovered and plenty of money.)
wait_until 30000 TheApp.ui ~= nil
lua rawset(_G, "auto_results", {})
lua rawset(_G, "auto_step", function(why) local s = rawget(_G, "auto_status"); if s.ok then s.ok = false; s.why = why end end)
log ---- blood_machine
lua TheApp:loadLevel(12, "full")
wait_until 30000 TheApp.world ~= nil and TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIInformation) ~= nil
lua TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIInformation):close(); local h = TheApp.ui.hospital; h.balance = 1000000; for _, d in pairs(h.room_discoveries) do d.is_discovered = true end; rawset(_G, "auto_status", {ok = true, why = ""})
lua require("sdl").native.post("pick_room", '{"id":"blood_machine"}')
wait 500
lua require("sdl").native.post("quick_build_customise", "{}"); rawset(_G, "auto_deadline", os.time() + 5)
wait_until 8000 (TheApp.native.editor ~= nil and TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom) and TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom).phase == "door") or os.time() > rawget(_G, "auto_deadline")
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed then auto_step("no editor"); return "no editor" end; local door = ed.edit.blueprint_door; local good, total = 0, 0; for _, m in ipairs(ed:markers()) do total = total + 1; ed:marker(m.id); if ed.edit.blueprint_door.valid then good = good + 1 end end; rawget(_G, "auto_status").doors = good .. "/" .. total; if good == 0 then auto_step("no door marker accepted") end; ed:pressed("auto_door"); return good .. " of " .. total .. " door markers accepted"
wait 300
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed then return end; if not ed.edit.blueprint_door.valid then auto_step("Suggest found no door") end; require("sdl").native.post("editor_button", '{"id":"next"}'); rawset(_G, "auto_deadline", os.time() + 5)
wait_until 8000 (TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom) == nil or TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom).phase == "windows") or os.time() > rawget(_G, "auto_deadline")
screenshot blood_machine_1_door
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed or ed.edit.phase ~= "windows" then auto_step("not at windows"); return end; local edit = ed.edit; local chosen; for _, m in ipairs(ed:markers()) do local x, y, w = m.id:match("^(%d+),(%d+),(%a+)$"); ed:marker(m.id); if edit:windowAt(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), w) then chosen = m.id; break end end; rawget(_G, "auto_status").window = chosen; return tostring(chosen)
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed then return end; require("sdl").native.post("editor_button", '{"id":"next"}'); rawset(_G, "auto_deadline", os.time() + 15)
wait_until 18000 (TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom) == nil or TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom).phase == "objects") or os.time() > rawget(_G, "auto_deadline")
wait 500
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed or ed.edit.phase ~= "objects" then auto_step("not at objects"); return end; rawget(_G, "auto_status").items = #ed.edit.objects; require("sdl").native.post("editor_button", '{"id":"place_rest"}')
wait 500
screenshot blood_machine_2_furniture
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed then return end; if #ed.edit.objects > 0 then auto_step(#ed.edit.objects .. " left after Auto") end; if not ed.edit.confirm_button.enabled then auto_step("Done not enabled") end; require("sdl").native.post("editor_button", '{"id":"done"}'); rawset(_G, "auto_deadline", os.time() + 5)
wait_until 8000 (TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom) == nil and TheApp.native.editor == nil) or os.time() > rawget(_G, "auto_deadline")
wait 300
lua local s = rawget(_G, "auto_status"); local room; for _, r in pairs(TheApp.world.rooms) do if r.room_info.id == "blood_machine" then room = r end end; if not room then auto_step("no room") elseif not room.built then auto_step("not finished") else local have = {}; for o in pairs(room.objects) do have[o.object_type.id] = (have[o.object_type.id] or 0) + 1 end; for obj, n in pairs(room.room_info.objects_needed) do if (have[obj] or 0) < n then auto_step("missing " .. obj) end end end; if TheApp.native.editor ~= nil then auto_step("editor still open") end; local line = ("%s %-18s doors %s window %s items %s %s"):format(s.ok and "OK  " or "FAIL", "blood_machine", tostring(s.doors), s.window and "yes" or "no", tostring(s.items), s.why); local results = rawget(_G, "auto_results"); results[#results + 1] = line; return line
screenshot blood_machine_3_built

wait 500
screenshot cardiogram_2_furniture
lua local ed = TheApp.native.editor; if not ed then return end; if #ed.edit.objects > 0 then auto_step(#ed.edit.objects .. " left after Auto") end; if not ed.edit.confirm_button.enabled then auto_step("Done not enabled") end; require("sdl").native.post("editor_button", '{"id":"done"}'); rawset(_G, "auto_deadline", os.time() + 5)
wait_until 8000 (TheApp.ui:getWindow(UIEditRoom) == nil and TheApp.native.editor == nil) or os.time() > rawget(_G, "auto_deadline")
